text:
maria: quick notenoticed spike in schema reject rate for /v1/invoke on canary-variant-3 this morning :eyes:

jake: confirmed. digging into rejects now. many are fncall outputs with an unexpected top-level `meta` field

sam-dev: example (sanitized):
```json
{"tool_result": {"status": "ok", "data": {"text": "..."}}, "meta": {"adapter": "legacy-bridge", "env": "staging"}}
```

maria: the validator schema is strict (only allows `tool_result`). these legacy adapters slipped in extra `meta` keys so strict mode is rejecting them

ops-alyssa: FYI sampling currently grabs rejects uniformly. if legacy adapters dominate rejects we risk false positives in canary metrics and will surface noisy alerts to PM/SRE

anya: would be helpful if console showed concrete examples in the route view instead of just counts. PM asked for "small number of top reject examples" + quick accept vs reject toggle

jake: agree. telemetry change idea: normalize reject reasons to stable codes (UNKNOWN_FIELD_META, MISSING_REQUIRED, TYPE_MISMATCH) instead of free text. easier to group and chart

sam-dev: +1. also add `reject_handling` to logs so we know whether a rejected request: `fallbacked_to_degen`, `returned_400`, or `coerced`. customers are seeing charges when we fallback, causing billing confusion

ops-alyssa: suggestion: two-stage sampling. sample accepts at a low baseline (0.5%) for context, sample rejects at higher rate but stratify by `adapter` header so legacy adapters don't swamp view. enforce per-org daily cap (20k) to limit storage

maria: make those sampling rates configurable per-org. also need a UI toggle per-route: `strict_schema=false|true` for canaries so SREs can opt into strict validation per-route

anya: UX: I'll mock a small "Examples" panel (shows up to 3 sanitized snippets) plus a warning pill when strict is enabled. include an estimated cost delta for last 24h based on fallback events

jake: implementation plan I can take:
- PR1: validator emits `reject_code` and `reject_adapter` fields (EOD tomorrow)
- PR2: telemetry sampling tag `schema_sample_stage` (baseline|stratified) and `reject_handling` (Wed)

sam-dev: I'll add backfill job to map historical free-text reject reasons -> new `reject_code` so dashboards remain consistent. mark backfill runs with `backfill_v2` label while it's running

ops-alyssa: also add metric `schema_sampling_overflow` so UI can indicate when sample cap was hit and examples are partial

qa_bot: tests: ensure PII scrubbing remains in place for example snippets. we'll run acceptance on sanitized logs only

maria: timeline check: need these in staging before we promote canary-variant-3 to 100% in EU next week

jake: can do PR1 tomorrow morning, PR2 mid-week. Anya can you deliver mocks by Tue noon?

anya: yes, will post screenshots and two states (strict on/off) Tue AM. include microcopy for the cost tooltip

sam-dev: final notes: add small migration to annotate past events with `reject_code` family and include an opt-out param for orgs who want legacy-accepts visible during gradual rollouts

maria: perfect. action list: Jake PR1/PR2, Sam-dev backfill & log fields, Anya mock PR3, Ops apply sampling caps, QA validate sanitization. ping me once PRs are up so we can validate in staging. :thumbsup:
